metadata.description: WISE Digital Partners plugins: the website build process by department, agency tools outside the build, and paid media.

plugins.name: website-build
plugins.description: The whole WISE website build process in one install: adds the Account Management, SEO & Content and Development plugins and the shared build skills. Use it for someone who works across departments.

plugins.name: build-shared
plugins.description: Shared website build skills used by more than one department: merging new client info into the kickoff context, sorting client feedback and edits, staging QA and the launch check, and GA4 goal tracking.

plugins.name: build-account-management
plugins.description: Account Management (AM / PM) website build skills: kickoff, welcome and weekly client emails, Kickoff Call brief and processing, end-of-week handoff checks, go-live email, case study and project close-out.

plugins.name: build-seo-content
plugins.description: SEO & Content website build skills: Client Reference Kit, keyword research, sitemap, content briefs, page copy, content QA, competitor research, Growth Blueprint and deck, the retainer roadmap, and live-site SEO checks.

plugins.name: build-development
plugins.description: Development website build skills: the dev handoff index and GO / NO-GO gate.

plugins.name: agency-tools
plugins.description: WISE skills outside the website build process: prospect digital audit for Sales, Google Ads audit and analysis, ClickUp progress sync, and sub-agent performance review.

plugins.name: paid-media-ops
plugins.description: Day-to-day paid media operations: client intake, pacing, account health, weekly optimization, anomaly triage, wasted spend, impression share, and task pushing.

plugins.name: paid-media-measurement
plugins.description: Conversion tracking audits, platform vs GA4 reconciliation, UTM governance, offline conversion imports, and lead quality audits.

plugins.name: paid-media-search
plugins.description: Search advertising: keyword research, search term mining, campaign builds, bid strategy, Google Ads and Performance Max audits, Local Services Ads.

plugins.name: paid-media-social
plugins.description: Paid social: Meta and LinkedIn audits, audience building, campaign builds, and creative fatigue checks.

plugins.name: paid-media-creative-compliance
plugins.description: Ad copy, creative briefs, swipe files, test planning, landing page message match, policy prechecks, industry restrictions, and launch readiness.

plugins.name: paid-media-strategy-reporting
plugins.description: Unit economics, media plans, forecasts, auction insights, monthly reports, executive summaries, and QBR decks.
